tools.name: verify_business
tools.description:
Is this business registered and still active? Covers Illinois and Florida.
Inputs: name (2-200 chars), optional state (IL, FL or the state's name; recommended), optional city (max 100), optional zip (5 digits or ZIP+4).
Which state: send state whenever you know it. Left out, every covered state is searched and the match carries registry_state. When the same name is the best match in more than one state and no ZIP picks one, the verdict is possible_match with flag found_in_multiple_states and states_found lists them: resend with state or the business's zip. Florida data comes from the state's quarterly file, so it can be up to about three months old. The state publishes only Active or Inactive, not the reason an entity is inactive.
Price: $0.02 per call, paid per call with x402. A monthly API key also works (one unit per call). Call coverage first (free).
Verdicts:
- active: Registered and in good standing, or still active with a status flag listed in flags.
- inactive: The state record shows the entity dissolved, revoked, withdrawn, merged or otherwise no longer active.
- possible_match: A record with a similar, not identical, name exists. Its status is in match.record_verdict. Confirm with the business's ZIP code, or by comparing the returned name, before relying on it. A similar-name match to a corporation always stays possible_match, because the state publishes no address for corporations.
- not_found: No matching record in the covered Illinois data. not_found does not mean the business is fake.
- unknown: A record exists but the data cannot say whether it still operates (Will County DBA filings, or an unrecognised status).
county_source says where county came from: office, registered_agent or county_filing. registered_agent means the county is the registered agent's county, so it is approximate (this applies to every corporation).
possible_match is confirmed only by a matching ZIP, never by city alone. not_found does not mean the business is fake: insurers, banks and other entities chartered outside the Secretary of State, and sole proprietors and general partnerships outside Will County, are not covered. Every record cites source_url and pulled_at.
Example call: {"name":"Maple Street Bakery LLC","state":"IL","zip":"60435"}
Example response: {"verdict":"active","confidence":1,"flags":["annual_report_current"],"match":{"name":"Maple Street Bakery LLC","record_verdict":"active","county":"Will","county_source":"office","source_url":"https://...","pulled_at":"2026-11-14T06:00:00.000Z"},"alternatives":[]}

- not_found: No matching record in the covered Illinois data. not_found does not mean the business is fake.
- unknown: A record exists but the data cannot say whether it still operates (Will County DBA filings, or an unrecognised status).

tools.name: new_filings
tools.description:
Which businesses newly registered in one Illinois county? Newest first, from the Secretary of State files (plus Will County assumed-name filings).
Inputs: county (required, one county per call, e.g. Will or DuPage), optional industry (text matched against industry_guess), optional since (YYYY-MM-DD, at most 90 days back, default 30), optional limit (1 to 50, default 20), optional include_foreign (true or false, default true).
Price: $0.05 per call, paid per call with x402. A monthly API key also works (one unit per call). Call coverage first (free).
county_source says where county came from: office, registered_agent or county_filing. registered_agent means the county is the registered agent's county, so it is approximate (this applies to every corporation).
Caveats: industry_guess is a guess from the business name, with industry_guess_basis saying how; it is often null. Foreign companies (formed in another state, registered in Illinois) are included by default and labelled foreign: true; send include_foreign false to leave them out. Every record cites source_url and pulled_at.
Example call: {"county":"Will","since":"2026-11-01","limit":5}
Example response: {"count":1,"total_matching":1,"records":[{"name":"Maple Street Bakery LLC","entity_type":"LLC","foreign":false,"filing_date":"2026-11-10","county":"Will","county_source":"office","industry_guess":null,"source_url":"https://...","pulled_at":"..."}],"data_as_of":{...},"notes":[]}

county.description: Illinois county name, for example Will or DuPage. One county per call.

industry.description: Optional text matched against industry_guess, for example construction.

since.description: Optional start date YYYY-MM-DD, at most 90 days back. Default 30 days.

include_foreign.description: Optional. false leaves out out-of-state companies registered in Illinois. Default true.

tools.name: verify_license
tools.description:
Is this Illinois professional (or licensed firm) licensed, and is the license active, expired or disciplined? From the state regulator's (IDFPR) public file. Use it only to verify a professional or vendor you contract with or are about to contract with. Not for employment screening of individuals, not for marketing or recruiting lists, not for profiling a person, and not for any decision covered by the Fair Credit Reporting Act.
Inputs: license_number, OR name (full name, or a firm's exact name) plus profession (for example nurse, real estate broker, CPA, roofing contractor). Optional city and zip only help choose between people with the same name. No partial names, no wildcards, no lists.
Price: $0.02 per call, paid per call with x402. A monthly API key also works (one unit per call). Call coverage first (free): it lists every license kind covered.
Verdicts:
- active: A license was found and the state lists it as active, with no public discipline on record.
- expired: A license was found, but it has expired or was not renewed.
- inactive_or_revoked: A license was found, but it is not in force (inactive, cancelled, suspended, revoked, terminated or similar).
- disciplined: A license was found and the state has public discipline on record for it. The license may still be active: read license_active and status. The discipline block gives the most recent action's category and date, then every action's category and dates; the state's lookup page has the record.
- possible_match: More than one license fits the name and profession, or one fits but its city or ZIP does not agree with the one you sent (flag location_not_matched). candidates lists each one's profession, city and license number: check again with the license number.
- not_found: No license fits. This does not prove the person is unlicensed: see not_found_note.
Returned for a match: the name as the state shows it, profession, license type and number, status, license_active, original issue and expiration dates, city and state, and whether public discipline is on record. Never a street address, ZIP, birth date, phone or e-mail. not_found does not prove a person is unlicensed. Not covered: professions IDFPR does not license (for example general contractors, electricians, plumbers, attorneys, insurance agents and teachers), controlled-substance licenses, security-guard registrations and firearm cards. A name must match the state's record: try the license number.
Example call: {"name":"Jane Q. Sample","profession":"registered nurse","city":"Joliet"}
Example response: {"verdict":"active","match":{"licensee_name":"JANE Q SAMPLE","profession":"REGISTERED PROFESSIONAL NURSE","license_type":"NURSING BOARD","license_number":"041000000","status":"ACTIVE","license_active":true,"original_issue_date":"2012-06-01","expiration_date":"2028-05-31","city":"JOLIET","state":"IL","discipline_on_record":false,"discipline":null},"candidates":[],"matched_on":"name_profession_and_city","source":{"attribution":"Contains information from the IDFPR Professional Licensing database, which is made available by the State of Illinois under the Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0."},"data_as_of":"2026-11-27"}

license_number.description: The Illinois license number, for example 041123456 (dots and spaces are ignored). Send this, or name plus profession.

name.description: The licensee's full name (first and last name), or a licensed firm's exact name. 3 to 120 characters. No partial names or wildcards.

profession.description: Required with name: the profession or license kind, for example nurse, real estate broker, CPA, roofing contractor. The coverage tool lists every kind.

city.description: Optional city, max 100 characters. Used only to choose between people with the same name.

zip.description: Optional ZIP code, 5 digits or ZIP+4. Used only to choose between people with the same name; never returned.
